_about: Battle stage geometry, shared by the game (src/ui/battle.js) and the art guides (tools/art/make_guides.py). Stage pixels; feet positions are where a sprite's feet touch the floor. floorEdge = the back edge of the arena floor; eyeLevel = the true horizon where perspective lines meet (about the fighters' head height).

explore._about: How exploration scenes sit on the stage (src/ui/scene.js FITS, tools/art/make_guides.py explore guides). The scene image (1536x1024) is scaled by `scale`; its floor's back edge (floorEdgeImage of the image height) lands at stage y floorEdgeStageY; a person standing at stage y refY is drawn at sizes.hero x spriteScale. Painted exploration scenes pan as one flat layer, so objects painted into them never lean.

painted._about: Painted scenes (art wave 04) were painted bigger than the guides asked (objects about 1.5 to 2.5 times), so people are drawn bigger to match (spriteScale replaces explore.spriteScale), with a gentler depth curve: the horizon used for sizes and floor parallax sits at stage y eyeStageY, so he isn't a giant at the front edge.
